format: Studio / Custom divisions (all Competition OS event types for the gate)
requirement: Studio / Custom eligibility (age division, amateur or professional status, level) is determined by the organizer. An entry in a division that uses a classification is not ready until an authorized event manager records a determination (user id, actor role, timestamp, outcome, reason code, criteria confirmed; no sensitive detail). Divisions that use no classification require none. Waivers cover event-policy matters only and never override age, status, level, membership, registration or the OD-02 under-18 restriction. Copy never claims DanceFlow verified NDCA registration, UCWDC membership or WSDC Points Registry eligibility.
enforcement_point: Server: updateCompetitionEntryEligibilityAction (authorized event managers only; required criteria derived from stored division labels and participant roles) and loadEntryOperationalGates in heat generation, floor planning and readiness.

tests.name: combination sweep: ready only when ALL of adult, applicable criteria and a permitted decision hold
every prohibited override subject is refused by a gate

interpretation_notes: Partially implemented, so not marked verified; the OD-03 gaps apply (entry confirmation inside the finalize SQL is not gated, check-in still uses the older test, determinations live in entries.metadata with no append-only history). Status applicability is derived from participant roles professional/student; level from the division skill label; both are DanceFlow organizer policy, not body definitions. Criteria are self-attested by the organizer; DanceFlow checks only that the organizer confirmed every applicable criterion. The 'authorized organizer or designated official' is any event manager (studio owner/admin, organizer owner/admin/staff, platform admin); no finer 'designated official' role exists. Independent review follow-ups: a determination carries a non-sensitive fingerprint of the division, labels and competitor ids and stops clearing the entry if any of them change; a missing division row fails closed; a division role label counts as a status classification and 'Open' counts as a classification when used as a level label. Known limitations: body_permitted_exception_applied does not yet record which body rule or criterion it applies to; membership/registration is not modelled (no gate; organizer attests it outside DanceFlow); determinations from the unmerged OD-03 shape (no role, criteria or fingerprint) no longer clear and must be re-recorded; SQL heat/scheduling paths that do not go through floorScheduleServer or readiness/actions.ts ignore this gate (activation-gate note).
